Hi Emily / Marketplace team,

Following up on our onboarding call last week — Contoso (partner) is ready to submit the initial offer for their single-tenant SaaS app but we want to pre-validate a few technical checks to avoid a rework during the publisher verification step.

Quick summary of asks:
- Confirm the minimal bundle of artifacts required for portal verification (manifest, test tenant, redirect URIs, security attestation).
- Any common pitfalls for SaaS offers that cause a technical gate fail (redirect formats, telemetry endpoints, billing metadata).
- Expected SLA/timing for the initial technical validation once we upload the draft offer.

I've attached a short publisher checklist (publisher-checklist.pdf) and the draft manifest (offer-manifest.yaml). Ben, Marissa, and Jonas — tagging you for any gaps before we push the draft to the portal.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop

Subject: Re: Publisher portal verification & offer QA — Contoso SaaS listing

Hi Lauren (and team),

Thanks for the materials — quick pointers before you submit the draft offer in the portal:

Required items for a SaaS single-tenant offer:
- Completed marketplace manifest (offer-manifest.yaml) — ensure skuId and planId match the portal entries.
- Test tenant + test user with access logs enabled (we use this to exercise provisioning flows).
- OAuth redirect URIs: use fully qualified HTTPS URIs; no localhost entries for production offers.
- Security attestation: either a SOC 2 Type II report or a signed attestation PDF indicating compliance controls.
- Billing metering hooks (if meter-based) or a pricing table for fixed subscription offers.

Common failures we see: missing trailing slash issues in redirect URIs, mismatched plan IDs between manifest and portal form, and missing scopes in the OAuth app registration.

Timing: once the draft is uploaded with all artifacts, the technical validation typically takes 3-5 business days. If something is unclear we’ll send a consolidated validation list back with specific portal line items.

I've attached the marketplace verification form for your records (verification-form.docx) and the docs page for technical validation: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/marketplace/technical-validation-checklist

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Support
mpn-support@microsoft.com

Subject: Re: Publisher portal verification & offer QA — Contoso SaaS listing

Thanks, Lauren / Azure team — I pulled together the things Emily asked for and validated locally against the checklist. Short notes:

What we uploaded to the draft offer (attached):
- offer-manifest.yaml (attached) — skuId/planId configured per Contoso mapping.
- Test tenant: contoso-test.onmicrosoft.com (user: marketplace-test@contoso.com) — provisioning flows exercised.
- OAuth app registration configured; redirect URI: https://app.contoso.com/auth/callback (screenshot attached: sso-redirect-screenshot.png).
- Pricing: 1 subscription tier (monthly), metering = none.
- Security evidence: Contoso provided a SOC 2 attestation PDF — will attach as soc2-attestation.pdf in the portal submission.

Open items we need help on:
1) Portal field mapping for the telemetry endpoint — the portal wants an endpoint URL and we currently use an internal metrics endpoint behind a VNet. Do you accept a proxy URL or do we need to expose a public endpoint for validation?
2) If the SOC 2 attestation is redacted (no control narratives), is that sufficient for the technical gate, or will the validator request full report?

Proposed next steps:
- We’ll upload the draft with the attachments today (offer-manifest + attestation + screenshot).
- Request that the validation team flag any redirect/OAuth-related rejections within 48 hours so we can iterate.

Ben Carter
Partner Integrations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@microsoft.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:05:37 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher portal verification & offer QA — Contoso SaaS listing

Hi Ben / Lauren,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the artifacts. A couple of validation notes after a first pass:

1) Redirect URI — the manifest redirect looks good but the portal shows a mismatch: the portal entry has https://app.contoso.com/auth/callback/ (note trailing slash) while the manifest has no trailing slash. Please ensure the manifest string matches exactly.

2) Telemetry endpoint — for validation we need a reachable endpoint that returns a 200 on GET /health (can be a simple static 200 response). A proxy URL is acceptable as long as it returns the expected response; we don’t need production telemetry, only a reachable health check.

3) SOC 2 attestation — a redacted attestation is acceptable for the technical gate, but our compliance team may request the unredacted report during catalog listing or co-sell enablement. Please mark that as to-follow if you prefer to keep the full report internal.

If you can push the manifest update (trailing slash) and a reachable health check by EOD tomorrow we’ll queue the offer for validation; expected turnaround still 3-5 business days.

Emily Zhang
Cloud Partner Manager — Azure Marketplace
Microsoft Corporation
